intents.name: greeting
responses: Hello! I'm ShopBot. How can I help you today?
Hi there! Ask me about hours, shipping, returns or products.

intents.name: hours
responses: We're open Monday-Friday 9am-6pm and Saturday 10am-4pm. We're closed on Sundays.

intents.name: location
responses: Our store is at 123 Main Street. We also ship anywhere in the country.

intents.name: shipping
responses: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and is free on orders over $50. You'll get a tracking link by email.

intents.name: returns
responses: You can return any unused item within 30 days for a full refund. Just bring your receipt or order number.

intents.name: payment
responses: We accept credit and debit cards, PayPal and cash in store.

intents.name: products
responses: We sell laptops, phones, headphones and accessories. Ask about a specific item and I'll tell you more!

intents.name: price
responses: Prices vary by product. Right now we have 15% off all headphones!

intents.name: contact
responses: You can reach a human at support@shopbot.example or call (555) 123-4567 during business hours.

intents.name: thanks
responses: You're welcome! Anything else I can help with?

fallback: Sorry, I didn't quite get that. You can ask about hours, location, shipping, returns, payment, products or prices.
